negative_findings.description: sportbank, named in the cell definition, appears to have been shut down on 17 April 2024; Tascombank now lists izibank as its only mobile-banking partner.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only historical sportbank items (incl. a 2023 finclub piece on a change of its head). No current sportbank hiring or leadership source found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's actor list is stale; sportbank should be treated as an archive-only actor and collection effort reallocated to live challengers.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated press/careers/leadership channel was found for izibank as a distinct brand — it is governed through Tascombank.
negative_findings.result_summary: izibank.com.ua surfaced only FAQ/product pages; management information sits on tascombank.ua.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership signals for izibank must be tracked at the licensing-bank level, not the brand level; a brand-level watch would return nothing.

negative_findings.description: The NBU dataset that publishes bank managers (запроваджено after NBU began publishing manager information) could not be pinned to a current bank.gov.ua URL in this pass; only an old.bank.gov.ua article and secondary reporting were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned zib.com.ua/NV coverage and legal commentary rather than the live dataset page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the authoritative regulator source for board-level moves at every licensed neobank partner; leaving it unpinned is the single biggest gap in the cell.

negative_findings.description: English-language search for 2026 monobank product-lead hires returned only company profiles and funding coverage, no people-level news.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: people-level neobank signals in UA are local-language and social-channel-borne; an English-only pipeline would miss essentially all of them.

negative_findings.description: No stable Ukrainian term was identified for 'card-issuing challenger'; local usage collapses to 'необанк' or 'мобільний банк-партнер'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on issuing-specific phrasing returned generic необанк overviews.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design must rely on brand names plus 'необанк'/'банк-партнер' rather than a functional issuing term, or recall will be poor.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn (company pages and individual title changes) was not scouted in this pass, despite being the canonical place a Ukrainian fintech product lead announces a new role.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a compliant LinkedIn watch (manual review or licensed data provider) for monobank/Fintech-IT Group, Tascombank, A-Bank, Unex Bank and their named founders/product leads.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent card-issuing / payment challengers that compete for the same talent (NovaPay, Sense SuperApp of Alfa/Sense Bank, Concord-successor fintechs, Wise/Payoneer-style local issuers) are outside the current actor list, yet appointments there (e.g. NovaPay's new CEO, Aug 2026) move people between the neobanks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cell actor map to NovaPay, Sense SuperApp and other licensed issuers; add them to the registry watchlist and media entity filters.

coverage_gaps.description: Founder channels other than Horokhovskyi's were not enumerated — no source pinned for Mykhailo Rohalskyi, the Dubilet brothers, or product leads (Instagram/Threads/Facebook), which the cell rationale says are primary.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass enumerating founder/product-lead personal accounts across Telegram, Instagram, Threads and Facebook, and register each as its own source.

coverage_gaps.description: Several access/legal assessments (DOU, Djinni, Facebook, Opendatabot/YouControl licensing) are hypotheses about robots.txt and ToS, not checked terms.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a robots.txt/ToS review for each collection target before any automated pull, and prefer paid API access for the registry aggregators.

coverage_gaps.description: Russian-language coverage (still used by parts of the UA fintech press and by some founder posts) was not searched, per run scope uk/en.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If scope allows, add ru query variants (назначен, новый руководитель, команда) to catch cross-posted announcements.

brief: For Ukrainian neobanks and card-issuing challengers, people-level intelligence is bifurcated: hard confirmation lives in state and regulator data (ЄДР via Opendatabot/YouControl, NBU approval of bank managers), while the early weak signal lives on founder-owned social channels and employer hiring channels — above all Oleh Horokhovskyi's Telegram 'ОГо!' and the official 'Робота в monobank' channel, supplemented by mono's careers page and DOU/robota.ua/work.ua listings whose role titles expose new verticals. Trade media (PaySpace Magazine, Фінансовий клуб, Fintech Insider) and the УАФІК association member list/event speaker rosters serve as pointer layers that keep the actor map current and surface appointments at smaller challengers. Two structural cautions: sportbank appears defunct since April 2024, and izibank has no brand-level governance channel — it must be tracked through Tascombank. The largest remaining gaps are LinkedIn (unscouted) and the personal channels of founders/product leads other than Horokhovskyi.
